Google’s new unit with Accenture, which The Wall Street Journal first reported, is the latest of its aggressive expansions of its FDE model this year as it attempts to resolve enterprise deployment bottlenecks and catch up to rivals. [...] The new unit, dubbed Accenture Gemini Enterprise Business Group, is Google’s latest foray into the increasingly competitive world of “forward-deployed engineers,” or FDEs. Rivals in the AI race, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft and Amazon, have all recently launched separate business units in a bet that implementing AI models can become its own trillion-dollar business. [...] Google isn’t the only giant at risk of being outpaced by newer firms. Companies that are dedicated specifically to embedding engineers into businesses to build bespoke AI workflows — like Ode with Anthropic, or OpenAI’s The Deployment Co. — threaten big consultancy firms like Accenture as well. On August 31, 2026, CNBC reported that Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) suffered a widespread Outlook and Exchange Online outage on August 31, with Downdetector reports peaking at 6,015 for Outlook and 2,044 for Microsoft 365. On the same day, OpenAI's ChatGPT Work, its enterprise AI agent that competes directly with Microsoft's own Copilot and with Anthropic's Claude Cowork, suffered a separate roughly three-hour outage, leaving users across multiple plans unable to start or continue tasks. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT)'s scale makes the latest Outlook and Exchange outage relatively small compared with the company's broader growth. Azure's continuous growth could keep supporting the investment case as demand for AI computing expands. OpenAI's ChatGPT Work outage gives little direct threat to Microsoft because Microsoft competes with ChatGPT Work through its own Copilot products while maintaining a broader cloud and software ecosystem. Azure hosts much of OpenAI's computing infrastructure, while ChatGPT Work increasingly competes with Microsoft 365 Copilot for enterprise AI spending.

highlights: 据彭博社9月8日报道，Anthropic决定放弃以高达 60 亿至 70 亿美元收购以色列 AI 算力优化初创公司 Decart AI 的交易
在冲刺IPO的关键节点，Anthropic放弃这笔原本有望成为其历史上最大规模的收购案，引发了科技界与美股一级市场的高度关注与疑惑：为什么在 IPO 前夕选择急刹车
Decart AI 专注于 AI 算力与芯片推理效率优化，其开发的DOS机能够跨平台提升芯片运算效率最高达 8 倍，同时还具备实时 AI 视频生成能力
